Name: Varais Apple Joja Furniture Retextures
Author: EmpressGalactic
Description:
╭✦🍎┆ Apple themed Joja retexture set part 1 ✦

This mod offers:
╭ ---------- ୨♡୧ ----------🐛
- Green and red apple themed furniture retextures
- A rework to some of the Joja interior (a full retexture set for the store will come soon!)
- A visually appealing aesthetic for people who enjoy brighter colours
- If an item didn't get a full recolour, if it has logos, the logos will be removed
- The pictures don't show every item that got retextured! There's lots more waiting for you!
- A mod that (may or may not, depending on the mods) be compatible with other item retextures
╰ ---------- ୨♡୧ ----------🐛


╰✦🍏┆ Thank you so much for supporting my mod! ✦
